feasibility.high_roi: A source-specific historical terminology/sign reference or neutral handwriting-feature annotation core after legitimate original-page verification. No personality/ability or employment judgment.
feasibility.procedures_needed: Verify actual named sign classes,slant direction convention,baseline/spacing units,pressure meaning,exceptions and contextual combinations. A contents page is not a decision procedure.
feasibility.inputs: Prefer manual generic teaching-sample labels or explicitly descriptive annotations. Original inventory scanned handwriting/optional CV retained as metadata,not implemented.
feasibility.numerical_scope: Any future slant/spacing computation must specify image rotation,baseline,resolution,script and units; pen pressure requires suitable evidence rather than a darkness proxy. No calculations implemented in this audit.
feasibility.tradition_isolation: French analytic,German holistic,American applied and feature dimensions remain separate; no universal sign-to-trait lookup assembled.
feasibility.scientific_boundary: Graphology is not reliable for personality or employment screening under inventory scope. Historical reference is not psychometric validation,clinical diagnosis or forensic authorship authentication. Shared visual vocabulary does not transfer evidentiary validity.
